queries: WITH qualifying_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT u.ID FROM Laboratory AS u WHERE u.`U-PRO` = '-' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS r WHERE r.ID = u.ID AND r.RA = '-')), per_patient AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_diff FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN qualifying_patients AS q ON q.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_tat_diff) AS avg_tat_diff FROM per_patient
